environment.description: Kafka consumer running on EKS with default service account. Kafka topic 'user-updates' has open ACLs (ALLOW * on WRITE). The UserAccount struct fields including api_key, hmac_secret, role, and is_admin are stored in-memory and used directly for authorization decisions. The hmac_secret and enc_key_ref fields contain plaintext key material or direct references that the application resolves locally via filesystem-mounted secrets.

config.hmac_resolution: application reads key bytes from path in hmac_secret field
config.authorization: in-process check on UserAccount.IsAdmin and UserAccount.Role
